candidate_grid: all unordered pairs among 212 series, four sign quadrants; equal-weight monthly returns
claim_limit: Portfolio-level maintained-return falsification only. Not stock-level point-in-time replication, capacity proof, SNDK detection, or capital permission.
cost_stress: 25 bps per month deducted from combination return
full_gate: falsification HAC-like t >2 using Newey-West lag 6
positive return in >=3 of 5 falsification calendar years
primary_test: one-sided mean return t-test in validation, BH-FDR globally across all pair/sign trials
purpose: Falsify or identify robust combinations among every pair of the 212 maintained Open Source Asset Pricing long-short predictor returns.
